) sfc on sfc.parent_user_id = m.user_id and sfc.student_user_id = m.student_user_id
si.student_id is not null

mapper.insert:
insert into sys_student_match ( student_id, user_id, student_user_id, match_status, create_time ) values
( #{item.studentId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.studentUserId}, #{item.matchStatus}, sysdate() )
on duplicate key update match_status = values(match_status), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update sys_student_match set user_id = #{userId}, student_user_id = #{studentUserId}, match_status = #{matchStatus}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from sys_student_match where not exists ( select 1 from sys_school_family_contact c where c.parent_user_id = sys_student_match.user_id and c.student_user_id = sys_student_match.student_user_id )
